source: Adoption: the owner's Mac, Cockpit build release-0.3.7-r1, standard task „Kit übernehmen“ (AGP_KIT_ADOPT_TASK_V1) from main e757911, PR #428 (merge 4b5f904), successor package #429 (main 436027ec); read from the Cockpit's decision box, the transcript of the mission and the PR. Retest: Claude's workspace, Cockpit main 436027ec with the agentic-project-kit 1.1.11 wheel from PyPI (sha256 c79bc14ef862940e07923d9396d177068984dba97646f19d4aad26f11e61ddd7, Python 3.13); machine paths left out here.

kit_update.controller: installed Kit 1.1.10 planned and executed the update inside the standard task „Kit übernehmen“
kit_update.owner_consent: the owner clicked „Kit übernehmen“ and released exactly `kit update --version 1.1.11 --execute --expected-signature f0a6c8f0abcb841f121017f6` in the decision box (AGP_OWNER_DECISION_EXECUTE_V1); „Abschließen“ merged PR #428 with CI green; „Chat wechseln“ afterwards PASS with the Cockpit's own package check (handoff projection v1, as 1.1.11 keeps v2 dormant)
kit_update.rejected_orders: steps 2209, 2210 and 2213 were correct work orders rejected for `'--self-test' in sys.argv[1:]` (AGP_SELF_TEST_ARGV_SLICE_V1, fixed in this slice)

cockpit_tests: Claude's workspace (Python 3.12 with Tk under xvfb, AGP_REQUIRE_TK=1): full suite green on this slice

verifies.KIT-GF-095: greenfield retest KIT-GF-095 PASS with the installed Kit 1.1.11 (real local Git adoption and return squashes, byte-exact v1 restoration, wrong state/version rejected); the Kit's 1.1.11 release stamped fixed_in 1.1.11 itself; KIT-GF-097 and KIT-GF-098 (real-wheel transition and return to the pinned predecessor) PASS as well

reverifies.KIT-GF-092: the Cockpit task read UPDATE_AVAILABLE 1.1.10 → 1.1.11 from the Kit's release check live; Systemcheck „1.1.11 ist das neueste stabile Release“
